choose.when: SELECT id,token,credential_type type,subject_name_snapshot ownerName,subject_id ownerId,CASE WHEN credential_type='visitor' THEN subject_id END visitorId,appointment_id appointmentId,DATE_FORMAT(valid_from,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') validFrom,DATE_FORMAT(valid_to,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') validTo,status FROM qr_codes ORDER BY valid_from DESC,id

SELECT r.id,DATE_FORMAT(r.occurred_at,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') time,r.person_name_snapshot name,r.person_id personId,r.person_type_snapshot type,r.method,g.name gate,r.result status FROM access_records r LEFT JOIN gates g ON g.id=r.gate_id WHERE r.record_kind='ACCESS' ORDER BY r.occurred_at DESC,r.id
SELECT d.id,d.name,d.device_type type,g.name gate,d.status FROM devices d JOIN gates g ON g.id=d.gate_id ORDER BY d.id
SELECT id,name,campus,location,CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(open_from,'%H:%i'),'-',DATE_FORMAT(open_to,'%H:%i')) openTime,status FROM gates ORDER BY id

SELECT r.id,r.role_key role,JSON_ARRAY(r.method) methods,CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(r.allowed_from,'%H:%i'),'-',DATE_FORMAT(r.allowed_to,'%H:%i')) allowedTime,JSON_ARRAY(g.name) gates,r.max_uses maxUses,r.status FROM access_rules r JOIN gates g ON g.id=r.gate_id ORDER BY r.id

SELECT id,NULL gateOpenTime,NULL gateCloseTime,visitor_qr_minutes visitorQrMinutes,alumni_qr_minutes alumniQrMinutes,face_threshold faceThreshold,high_risk_auto_block highRiskAutoBlock FROM access_settings WHERE id='main'

INSERT INTO qr_codes(id,token,credential_type,subject_name_snapshot,subject_id,appointment_id,valid_from,valid_to,status,max_uses,used_count,issuance_phase) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.token},#{row.type},#{row.ownerName},#{row.ownerId},#{row.appointmentId},STR_TO_DATE(#{row.validFrom},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),STR_TO_DATE(#{row.validTo},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),#{row.status},COALESCE(#{row.maxUses},1),0,CASE WHEN #{row.status}='预备' THEN 'PREPARED' ELSE 'ACTIVE' END)

INSERT INTO access_records(id,record_kind,occurred_at,person_name_snapshot,person_id,person_type_snapshot,method,gate_id,result) VALUES(#{row.id},'ACCESS',STR_TO_DATE(#{row.time},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),#{row.name},#{row.personId},#{row.type},#{row.method},(SELECT id FROM gates WHERE name=#{row.gate}),#{row.status})
INSERT INTO devices(id,name,device_type,gate_id,status) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.name},#{row.type},(SELECT id FROM gates WHERE name=#{row.gate}),#{row.status})

INSERT INTO gates(id,name,campus,location,open_from,open_to,status) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.name},#{row.campus},#{row.location},STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{row.openTime},'-',1),'%H:%i'),STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{row.openTime},'-',-1),'%H:%i'),#{row.status})

INSERT INTO access_rules(id,role_key,method,gate_id,allowed_from,allowed_to,max_uses,status) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.role},JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(#{row.methods},'$[0]')),(SELECT id FROM gates WHERE name=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(#{row.gates},'$[0]'))),STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{row.allowedTime},'-',1),'%H:%i'),STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{row.allowedTime},'-',-1),'%H:%i'),#{row.maxUses},#{row.status})

INSERT INTO access_settings(id,visitor_qr_minutes,alumni_qr_minutes,face_threshold,high_risk_auto_block) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.visitorQrMinutes},#{row.alumniQrMinutes},#{row.faceThreshold},#{row.highRiskAutoBlock})

UPDATE qr_codes SET token=#{row.token},credential_type=#{row.type},subject_name_snapshot=#{row.ownerName},subject_id=#{row.ownerId},appointment_id=#{row.appointmentId},valid_from=STR_TO_DATE(#{row.validFrom},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),valid_to=STR_TO_DATE(#{row.validTo},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),status=#{row.status},issuance_phase=CASE WHEN #{row.status}='有效' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE issuance_phase END WHERE id=#{row.id}

UPDATE access_records SET occurred_at=STR_TO_DATE(#{row.time},'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'),person_name_snapshot=#{row.name},person_id=#{row.personId},person_type_snapshot=#{row.type},method=#{row.method},gate_id=(SELECT id FROM gates WHERE name=#{row.gate}),result=#{row.status} WHERE id=#{row.id}
UPDATE devices SET name=#{row.name},device_type=#{row.type},gate_id=(SELECT id FROM gates WHERE name=#{row.gate}),status=#{row.status} WHERE id=#{row.id}

UPDATE gates SET name=#{row.name},campus=#{row.campus},location=#{row.location},open_from=STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{row.openTime},'-',1),'%H:%i'),open_to=STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{row.openTime},'-',-1),'%H:%i'),status=#{row.status} WHERE id=#{row.id}

UPDATE access_rules SET method=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(#{row.methods},'$[0]')),gate_id=(SELECT id FROM gates WHERE name=JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(#{row.gates},'$[0]'))),allowed_from=STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{row.allowedTime},'-',1),'%H:%i'),allowed_to=STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(#{row.allowedTime},'-',-1),'%H:%i'),status=#{row.status} WHERE id=#{row.id}

UPDATE access_settings SET visitor_qr_minutes=#{row.visitorQrMinutes},alumni_qr_minutes=#{row.alumniQrMinutes},face_threshold=#{row.faceThreshold},high_risk_auto_block=#{row.highRiskAutoBlock} WHERE id=#{row.id}
DELETE FROM qr_codes WHERE id=#{row.id}
DELETE FROM access_records WHERE id=#{row.id}
DELETE FROM devices WHERE id=#{row.id}
DELETE FROM gates WHERE id=#{row.id}
DELETE FROM access_rules WHERE id=#{row.id}
DELETE FROM access_settings WHERE id=#{row.id}

mapper.select: SELECT id FROM qr_codes WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE qr_codes SET used_count=used_count+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='有效' AND used_count<max_uses
mapper.select: SELECT request_digest,response_json FROM (SELECT request_digest,source_response response_json FROM access_records WHERE record_kind='REQUEST' AND request_id=#{id})x
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO access_records(id,record_kind,request_id,request_digest) VALUES(SHA2(CONCAT('REQUEST:',#{id}),256),'REQUEST',#{id},#{digest}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.update: UPDATE access_records SET source_response=#{response} WHERE record_kind='REQUEST' AND request_id=#{id}
UPDATE access_records SET event_payload=#{payload},exception_sync_status='PENDING',sync_attempts=0,next_retry_at=NOW(3) WHERE record_kind='ACCESS' AND id=SUBSTRING(#{id},8)
